# B"H
<!-- Boruch Hashem -->
<!-- Blessed is He -->

# Post-Completion Phase One: Residual Surface Brainstorm

> The Awtsmoos keeps revealing polish after the meadow learns to stride;
> Awtsmoos.com lets no stale breadcrumb or needless request remain outside.

## Observed Residuals

1. Fresh browser traces report one unrelated request to `/favicon.ico` returning HTTP 404.
2. `index.html` declares no icon, so Chrome falls back to the site root.
3. `NEXT_AI_README.md` names retired entry `createEretz3DDemo.js` and retired global `window.Awtsmoos`.
4. `REMAINING_WORK.md` still claims modules, route verification, and browser checks are incomplete.
5. The tracked runtime-media tree is intentionally excluded from Git and must not receive the route icon.

## Possible Repairs

- Add a global root favicon, but that widens scope across every Awtsmoos route.
- Add a route-owned SVG favicon beside `index.html`, avoiding global coupling.
- Embed a data-URL favicon directly in HTML, but that makes the shell harder to inspect and cache.
- Reuse an unrelated site logo, but that confuses product identity.
- Create a small Mitzvah World SVG with no external dependencies.
- Add a focused route-shell test that verifies icon declaration, entry module, stylesheet, and root markers.
- Rewrite both handoff files from the production evidence already captured.

## Phase-One Preference

Use a route-owned tracked SVG beside `index.html`, add one explicit `<link rel="icon">`, add a small source test, and rewrite the two stale handoff files in full. Do not touch CompactJS, gameplay source, Drive assets, or global site routing.
